core_confidence.policy: Midpoint of prior selected positive max and presumed-negative min, fixed before prediction. This is an exploratory replacement for length-confounded whole-chain ipTM, not a validated affinity gate.

tag_screen.interpretation: Conservative tag-interference flag, not proof that a flexible tag cannot touch the target. Tags never contribute to core hotspot or confidence scores.

tag_provenance: Exact publicly documented platform-default suffix; challenge page confirms C-terminal Twin-Strep capture but does not independently specify this full suffix.
placeholder_note: Tag backbone coordinates merely ensure parser/export completeness. Entire binder plus tag is excluded from structure templates; no tag conformation is supplied to the model.
scope: Fresh reserve confirmation and platform-default-tag sensitivity

selection_rule.ranking: Lowest symmetric mean PAE across ALL 194 target residues and binder CORE only; tie by sample index. No geometry/contact/shift-based sample selection.

geometry_screen.replicates: ONE seed/sample; screening only, not a qualified parent
geometry_screen.controls: 2DS25.5 selected model must recover fold<=2A, native-contact recall>=0.5, interface pose<=2A, ipTM>=0.5 in both seeds; presumed negatives must not reach 0.5 interface ipTM in selected models
geometry_screen.families: Exploratory complete-link clustering: >=30% identity OR equal-length self-fit CA RMSD<=3A joins a family; inspect before any expansion
geometry_screen.decision: Cost/quality checkpoint after 200. No automatic expansion. Shortlist at most 30 diverse leads for deep evaluation.
geometry_screen.limits: Self-consistency is not binding validation. Low-score exclusions are not demonstrated nonbinders. No affinity or pH claims. Mouse compatibility remains untested.
geometry_screen.ranking: Within binder class: geometry eligibility first, then equal-weight percentile ranks of interface ipTM descending, contact-pair PAE ascending, hotspot fraction descending, binder fold RMSD ascending. Sequence diversity selection at 80% identity; preserve epitope representation.
geometry_screen.nanobody_confidence: Record ipTM>=0.5 as descriptive only; no validated positive VHH control on this target.
geometry_screen.control_policy: One-sample matched 2DS25.5 plus presumed negatives; fail blocks advancement, does not trigger automatic reruns.

preparation.interpretation: Uniform post-hoc sensitivity analysis, specified before revised outcomes; never replaces raw or v1 decisions.
preparation.method: Amber14/GBn2, 12 A cutoff, both backbones restrained; all side chains and hydrogens mobile
preparation.protonation: Strip explicit H; PROPKA assigns H consistently to free and bound forms of the same prepared conformation. Any incomplete/protonation-failed group invalidates that calculation.
preparation.cohort: All confidence-selected reserve confirmation bare/tagged models, including failures and controls.
preparation.movement_scope: Target and binder-core backbone guards; full-tag movement also reported. The suffix is restrained during preparation but cannot disqualify the core solely by its flexible backbone displacement.
preparation.policy: One preparation per source; no selective retries; source sequence and original atom identities preserved; raw screen failures cannot be rescued. Original pose/contact/context gates and pKa heuristics unchanged.
limitations: No unbound ensemble or full proton linkage
Finite minimization is not proof of convergence or global stereochemical validity

prospective_plan.authorization: Fresh user-authorized follow-up to an unqualified reserve; the prior automatic follow-up remains skipped.
prospective_plan.selection: Identical target-integrity filter and minimum binder-core cross PAE to the prior tag experiment; do not choose poses by geometry, pKa or tag contacts.
prospective_plan.raw_screen: Unchanged binder-core structural checks, prior calibrated cross-PAE threshold, contact PAE <=10 A; raw positive/negative controls must separate in each condition and both seeds.
prospective_plan.preparation: Unchanged v2 tag-aware numerical preparation on every selected full construct. Strict target/core movement and internal geometry; full suffix motion also recorded. No selective retries or raw-failure rescue.
prospective_plan.primary_readout: Descriptive held-out replication: report His41 free/bound pKas, bound-minus-free shift and His-only Kd6/Kd7.4 proxy continuously in both conditions and both seeds, with structural eligibility, matched baselines and controls. No new pass threshold replacing the old free-pKa band.
prospective_plan.legacy_result: Also apply the unchanged free-pKa 6-7, shift <=-0.5, ratio >=2, target termini >=10 A and full prepared-control gates. Report that result explicitly; it is not overwritten by the continuous readout.
prospective_plan.sensitivity: Separately record the already-declared interface movement sensitivity on core structures. No automatic promotion from a sensitivity-only result.
prospective_plan.tag_policy: Full-construct chemistry for both free and bound calculations; only core His41 enters His-only ratio. Tag histidines are not counted as designed mechanism. Report all tag-target contacts, their PAE, reproducibility, and full-context clashes. Flexible uncertain contacts are flags, not experimental incompatibility.
prospective_plan.ablation_policy: H41A on redesigned background tests modeled fold/pose preservation. A zero introduced-His score is tautological, not evidence that the ablation lacks experimental pH sensitivity; tag and other titratable residues remain.
prospective_plan.decision: Archive outcomes without changing the frozen eight-design submission. No further paid job, new generation, alternative seeds or submission in this round. Recommend next action from the complete evidence; no automatic promotion.
limitations: Selected after observing a promising reserve; not an unbiased discovery screen
Same predictor, fresh seeds; no independent model validation
Fixed bound conformation, no unbound ensemble or full proton linkage
Platform-default suffix, not confirmed challenge-specific construct
No experimental binding, pH or mouse claims
